title: $R^3$-Bench: LLMs Struggle with Resource-Rational Reasoning under Shared Budgets
abstract: arXiv:2608.16033v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In cognitive science, resource rationality asks how an agent should allocate limited computation to maximize expected value. Most reasoning and agent benchmarks use independent per-task budgets; existing shared-budget studies do not calibrate suite performance against the same model's demonstrated single-problem competence. We introduce $R^3$-Bench, which evaluates six-problem suites under shared budgets across mathematics, competitive programming, and abstract reasoning in tool-free and agentic settings. Matched single-problem response curves define an offline empirical oracle over observed successes. Across 72 main-table cells for six models, the oracle mean matches or exceeds the contest mean in all cells and is strictly higher in 71. Under moderate tool-free pressure, equal-allocation replay also exceeds contest performance for four of six models. Trajectory diagnostics reveal limited strategy updating and pressure-dependent failure

translated_title: $R^3$-Bench：大型语言模型在共享预算下的资源理性推理中表现挣扎
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16033v1 公告类型：新 摘要：在认知科学中，资源理性探讨的是智能体应如何分配有限的计算资源以最大化预期价值。大多数推理和智能体基准测试使用独立的每任务预算；现有的共享预算研究并未针对同一模型在单问题上的已展示能力来校准套件性能。我们引入了$R^3$-Bench，该基准在数学、竞争性编程和抽象推理中，于无工具和智能体设置下评估共享预算下的六问题套件。匹配的单问题响应曲线定义了一个基于观测成功率的离线经验预言机。在六个模型的72个主表格单元中，预言机均值在所有单元中均匹配或超过竞赛均值，并在71个单元中严格更高。在适度的无工具压力下，均等分配重放对于六个模型中的四个也超过了竞赛表现。轨迹诊断揭示了有限的策略更新和依赖压力的失败模式。
tldr: 本文提出了$R^3$-Bench基准，揭示大型语言模型在共享预算下的资源理性推理能力不足，且通过经验预言机显示模型表现远低于其单问题能力上限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces $R^3$-Bench, revealing that large language models struggle with resource-rational reasoning under shared budgets, with an empirical oracle showing performance far below their single-problem competence ceiling.
